Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

May 28th 1927

Sir,

It is reported that Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 is receiving
$1,000.00 per month from the resident for secret service
work.

Fifteen hundred soldiers arrived in Shanghai by
train from the north in the early morning of 27th inst.
It is said that these troops will soon be dispatched to
Pokien. They are at present in the vicinity of the Arsenal.

A transport with one thousand men and a large
quantity of ammunition on board arrived at the Arsenal
from Nanking on 27th instant. It is reported that these
troops have been sent here to take part in the attack on
Chekiang.

Chen Chi Mei's coffin was removed from No.11 Sing Ming
Li, Rue Chapel to the Soochow Guild just before daybreak
on 27th instant. The coffin was followed by some twenty
persons nearly all of whom were relatives of deceased.

It is reported that the Woosung troops will resent
being sent to fight Chekiang, and it is feared that they
may mutiny. Special precautions are on this account being
taken in Chapel and Kiangnan Arsenal.

It is reported that a number of Cantonese who are
rebels have recently been successful in securing employment
in the Arsenal works.

It is reported that Hyou Tin Sung 何天炯 is trying
to cause trouble in Soochow and Joosieh in the hope of
causing a diversion and upsetting the Government plans
in regard to the proposed attack on Chekiang.

Your Obedient Servant,

William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Entered on MS May 29
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海公共租界工部局。

（印：上海公共租界工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1927年5月28日

先生：

据报，虞洽卿每月从该居民处收取1,000.00美元，作为秘密工作经费。

本月27日清晨，一千五百名士兵乘火车从北方抵达上海。据悉，这些部队不久将被派往福建。他们目前位于兵工厂附近。

本月27日，一艘载有一千名士兵及大量弹药的运输船从南京抵达兵工厂。据报，这些部队被派来此处，参与对浙江的进攻。

本月27日黎明前，陈其美的灵柩从霞飞路星明里11号移至苏州会馆。送葬者约二十人，几乎均为死者亲属。

据报，吴淞部队对被派往浙江作战心怀不满，令人担忧其可能发动兵变。为此，在霞飞路及江南兵工厂已采取特别预防措施。

据报，近期有多名身为反叛分子的广东人成功在兵工厂内谋得职位。

据报，何天炯正试图在苏州和嘉兴制造事端，以期声东击西，扰乱政府关于拟议进攻浙江的计划。

您忠实的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察

于5月29日录入手稿
警务处总监
